title: Market Intelligence & B2B SaaS Gap Engine
description: Auditable market research database tracking raw discussions, extracted pain points, clusters, and validated ideas.

raw_items.description: Scraped raw discussions from Reddit, Hacker News, StackOverflow, GitHub, Shopify Reviews, AlternativeTo, and YouTube.

columns.source: Platform and identifier (e.g. reddit:r/devops, shopify:recharge, youtube:indiehackers)
columns.url: Direct URL or timestamp deep link to original post
columns.score: Upvotes, stars, or likes on source platform
columns.mentioned_incumbent: Incumbent software explicitly identified in review

pain_points.description: Structured pain points extracted via LLM with verbatim quotes and severity levels.

clusters.description: Problem clusters formed by BERTopic embedding and HDBSCAN noise rejection.

columns.size: Number of pain points in cluster
columns.source_diversity: Distinct number of data sources backing this cluster
columns.wtp_evidence_count: Number of pain points with explicit willingness to pay evidence

ideas.description: Scored B2B SaaS opportunities with per-axis citations, trend validations, and wedges.

top_ideas_with_evidence.title: Top Ideas With Audit Evidence
top_ideas_with_evidence.description: Joins ideas -> clusters -> pain_points -> raw_items to trace every claim back to raw URLs and quotes.
top_ideas_with_evidence.sql: SELECT i.name, i.score_total, i.wedge, i.icp, i.trend_verdict, p.summary AS sample_pain, r.url AS source_url, r.source FROM ideas i JOIN clusters c ON i.cluster_id = c.id JOIN pain_points p ON p.cluster_id = c.id JOIN raw_items r ON p.raw_item_id = r.id ORDER BY i.score_total DESC;

pain_frequency_by_source.title: Pain Frequency by Source & Date
pain_frequency_by_source.description: Aggregated pain point frequency across sources over time for Vega chart visualization.
pain_frequency_by_source.sql: SELECT r.source, date(r.created_utc, 'unixepoch') AS scan_date, count(p.id) AS pain_count FROM pain_points p JOIN raw_items r ON p.raw_item_id = r.id GROUP BY r.source, scan_date ORDER BY scan_date DESC;
